snippet.title: CSYE 7270: Twenty Multiple-Answer Questions
snippet.description:
CSYE 7270: Twenty Multiple-Answer Questions

Private review draft for CSYE 7270 midterm preparation. Based on the current local draft exam coach and course knowledge sheet. The real exam and its answer key are not included. The coach has not been tested in a live Claude Project or custom GPT and is not yet published.

Current scope clarification: knowing what PBR is and why it matters is included. Detailed PBR techniques and experience with a PBR-based No-Bake system are not required.

Public course book:
https://github.com/nikbearbrown/csye-7270-building-virtual-environments

The draft coach source files are local and under review; no public prompt link is available yet.

Narration: Liam, a synthetic voice, in for Bear. Native 4K review master.
